title: [BUG] Cant remove mcp server
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version:0.2.45
- Operating System: macos
- Terminal: iTerm

## Bug Description

I can see the mcp server, and can get it, but can't remove it.

```
➜  expo git:(main) ✗ claude mcp list
github: npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-github
brave-search: npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-brave-search
gdrive: npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-gdrive
figma: npx figma-mcp

➜  expo git:(main) ✗ claude mcp remove figma
No local MCP server found with name: figma

➜  expo git:(main) ✗ claude mcp get figma
figma:
  Scope: global
  Type: stdio
  Command: npx
...
```
author: noqcks
